misses.evidence_span: They are very very rude and do not listen to your concern at all
misses.text:
Horrible customer service

Just so horrible the executives are. No proper hold notice given on calls. They give fake promises incident is raised and give a fake number or the order number itself and they hung upon me so many times. When the next executive talks, he or she cannot find any details with the incident id previous person gave. They are very very rude and do not listen to your concern at all. Myntra has become the worst these days and never expected such horrible experience. Their employees must be trained and given proper process knowledge, empathy and know how to quickly respond using their resources. I’ve been on hold for more than 30 mins and they keep hanging upon me. When asked, they give this lamest bullcrap answer that they do not have an option to hang up calls. They think we are fools to believe such lies. Shut down Myntra if such worst experience is given to the customers.

misses.evidence_span: has not delivered yet
misses.text:
Pathetic customer service

Myntra’s customer service sucks as it is now only managed by AI bots. My order from 24 October 2026 which was supposed to be delivered on 01 November 2026 has not delivered yet and till date they have no update on the product delivery. Looks like Mynta thinks they are above everyone and the customer service is optional
